opportunities.name: Nearest Spin Shred
opportunities.objective: Compare early and post-six-strike E packets with a nearby decoy unit.
opportunities.mechanic: E increases damage to the nearest enemy and shreds armor after six strikes. Stridebreaker access and Cleaver physical shred may help the later spins; Shojin tests ability/passive amplification and AD investment without assuming every E strike is an attack on-hit.
opportunities.requiredState: Stay the nearest unit to the intended target and land at least six E strikes.
opportunities.failure: A nearer minion redirects bonus damage or the target exits before shred.
opportunities.test: Compare early and post-six-strike E packets with a nearby decoy unit; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Nashor/Rageblade on-hits are not automatically applied per spin.

opportunities.name: Perseverance Reset Duel
opportunities.objective: Measure second-entry health and Q trade after a controlled eight-second reset.
opportunities.mechanic: P heals a percentage of max health after eight seconds without qualifying damage. Q removes slows and gives movement for disengage; earned Heartsteel health and W's health shield support a second entry. Trinity rewards Q's actual attack and Randuin helps control the exit/return.
opportunities.requiredState: Record earned health, W unit stacks and an eight-second safe break.
opportunities.failure: DoT/chip resets recovery or disengage surrenders the objective.
opportunities.test: Measure second-entry health and Q trade after a controlled eight-second reset; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: In-combat waiting does not enable Perseverance.

ruledOut.reason: R is true missing-health damage; magic penetration cannot amplify it.

Compare early and post-six-strike E packets with a nearby decoy unit; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A nearer minion redirects bonus damage or the target exits before shred.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Nashor/Rageblade on-hits are not automatically applied per spin.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Stridebreaker, Black Cleaver, Spear of Shojin, Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
